summary: M2 of issue #79: run_episode re-observes the tray pose and scene epoch before each decision, after each action, at duplicate intent and at verification, and binds every claim to that observed goal digest, so a moved target is replanned instead of judged against a stale pose. Reuses the existing Oracle acceptance and ClaimGuard surface; no new signer or privilege.

components.owning_subsystem: Embodied M2 episode runner, claim receipts and Oracle verification surface
components.disposition: Add goal_binding.py (GoalBinding: canonical pose at 1e-6 m, sha256(kind, pos), scene_epoch, monotonic version). run_episode re-observes the target and epoch at four points and, on change, invalidates claims, rebinds and replans (SCENE_RESET / GOAL_CHANGED_MID_ACTION / GOAL_CHANGED_BEFORE_VERIFICATION / DUPLICATE_INTENT_STALE_GOAL). make_receipt records the binding; verify_receipt, verify_receipt_fields and ClaimGuard.evaluate_claim accept expected_goal_digest and fail closed on a missing block, a tampered block or a block for another goal. max_goal_rebinds (default 4) bounds endless motion and ends in hold_unknown, never success. Indeterminate execution outranks a concurrent move and ends in hold_unknown_pending_reconciliation without a verdict. No new authority: VERIFIED still requires the UID463-signed Oracle acceptance.
evidence: Defect and fix are stated against M1 code in docs/embodied-m2-moving-target.md: M1 cached the observed tray_pos once before the action loop and judged every place claim against it; the receipt carried only scene_epoch, so the evidence did not name the goal the claim was about.

tests/embodied_m2/test_moving_target_runner.py: 11 deterministic scenarios (move while deciding; move during an action, with the voided action kept visible and tagged with the goal it ran against; out-of-band move between actions; move while release settles before verification; scene reset mid-episode; duplicate intent after a move; indeterminate execution; indeterminate execution plus concurrent move where HOLD wins; replay of a voided action surfacing as stale-duplicate; rebind budget; M1 t_s trace regression).
tests/embodied_m2/test_goal_binding.py: digest stability and noise, stale receipt, missing goal block, tampered block, stale epoch — every case fails closed.

tests/embodied_m2/test_mujoco_moving_target.py: real MuJoCo scene with the tray moved environment-side (model.body_pos + mj_forward) and real contact physics; includes a discrimination proof — the same final snapshot fails against the old pose and passes against the new one.

M1 physics revalidated under the M2 runner: experiments/embodied/m1/calibration/M1-baseline-v1.8.json records 10/10 engineering seeds deterministic with policies, tolerances, budgets and step counts unchanged; v1.7 stays frozen as the pre-M2 record.
Full local gate R9 reached exit 0 (ci_gate 全链路通过) on tree 5bbfb5424 before this manifest was added; the manifest-amended SHA must establish its own R9 exit 0 and independent reviewer PASS.

g1.necessity: M1 bound the goal once before the action loop: run_episode cached the observed tray pose and judged every place claim against it. A target that moves makes the cached pose a different goal, so either a real place is rejected forever (stale goal) or a place is verified against a pose the cube never reached (goal drift plus luck). Because the receipt carried only scene_epoch, nothing in the evidence said which goal a claim was about, and no gate could reject a stale-goal claim.

g2.authority_owner: The UID463-signed Oracle acceptance and the Host review gates remain the only verifier and signer; the episode runner and ClaimGuard stay enforcement-only and cannot mint VERIFIED.
g2.non_duplication: make_receipt, verify_receipt, verify_receipt_fields and ClaimGuard.evaluate_claim are reused and only gain a goal block plus expected_goal_digest. A missing block, a block whose digest does not match its own pose, or a block for another goal all return FAILED_CLAIM. Indeterminate execution and an exhausted rebind budget end in hold_unknown, which is not success.

g3.recovery_or_reason: Model narrative, HOLD/pending states and receipts bound to earlier SHAs are not acceptance. The only recovery path is a fresh observation, a fresh receipt bound to the current goal digest and a real UID463-signed Oracle acceptance.
